name: Special Occasion Wear
shortDescription: Wedding, engagement and gala pieces built around your event date with dedicated fitting sessions.
fabricNotes: Silk dupioni, satin, lace overlay, brocade and structured tulle, sourced or client-supplied.
highlights: Dedicated timeline planning around your event date
Beadwork, embroidery and appliqué on request
Bridal party coordination for matching or complementary looks
Final fitting scheduled within a week of the event
body: Occasion pieces carry more pressure than everyday clothing — there's one date, and it isn't moving. We build a fitting timeline backwards from your event so there's always room for a final adjustment.
From wedding gowns and grooom's suits to gala dresses and engagement outfits, every piece is built with room for last-fitting tailoring as your day approaches.
We coordinate bridal parties on request, matching fabric, colour or silhouette across multiple garments.

seo.title: Wedding & Special Occasion Tailoring
seo.description: Bespoke wedding, engagement and gala wear built around your event timeline at Lipek Fashion.
